name: HEDISDataSource
title: HEDIS Data Source
description: This code system defines codes to identify HEDIS data sources per HEDIS audit rules.

concept.definition: Administrative data as from a financial system
Supplemental data as approved by a HEDIS auditor
Sourced from an electronic health record (EHR) system
Standard clinical data collected in a care setting or provided via an API
Sourced from a health information exchange (HIE) or other data aggregator
Sourced from a clinical data or disease registry
Sourced from a case management system, either internal or delegated to another organization
